test_case.test_name: Reject BMC Update with Corrupt Update Image — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify AST1060/PFR rejects a deliberately malformed or integrity-corrupted BMC capsule for the explicitly selected active or recovery update path before any unsafe write/activation, leaving firmware, recovery content and boot health unchanged.
required_package: Known-good capsule plus documented corruption method/location and hashes
Exact active or recovery update endpoint/path and expected rejection stage/error/event
Stable isolated SUT, console, golden image/programmer rollback
test_case.test_command: Capture PFR lifecycle, active/recovery versions/hashes and BMC health; create/obtain a validly attributable capsule with one documented corruption type while preserving a known-good original; approve exact target path; isolate system and ready golden/programmer recovery; submit once; capture parser/signature/integrity rejection stage/status/event; prove neither active nor recovery region staged/written/activated and BMC services remain healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for Reject BMC Update with Corrupt Update Image. The protected Criteria is `1. AST1060 should reject the update`; it becomes enforceable only after resolving: Resolve Functionality row 2281 Wistron-HW-00247-V003: approve BMC/AST1060/PFR build/lifecycle and whether active, recovery or separately both paths are in scope; known-good capsule and exact reproducible corruption type/location with hashes; expected parser/signature/integrity rejection stage, task/status/error/PFR event and timeout; required proof of no staging/write/activation or active/recovery hash/version/config change; stable power, isolated target and golden/programmer rollback.
safety_gate: Validate corruption and target offline; preserve known-good image
Perform one attempt with stable power and independent recovery
Stop if write/stage/activation/reboot begins or region hash changes
Never target both regions ambiguously, retry, or clear evidence
expected_evidence: PFR state and active/recovery version/hash baseline
Good/corrupt capsule hashes and documented binary difference
Proof no stage/write/activation or region/version/config change
Final BMC boot/services and rollback readiness plus engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Choose active and recovery path coverage explicitly; if both are required, treat them as separately authorized subchecks with recovery verification between them.
